_comment: Exact advisory exceptions for unfixed build-only dependencies. The audit gate fails on any new advisory ID or an expired review date.

advisories.exposure: build-only / file watcher and glob matcher
advisories.reason: The stack-exhaustion issue requires a deeply nested attacker-controlled glob. This static-site project uses braces only for local build-time file watching and repository-controlled glob matching; it is not bundled into the deployed site. npm reports no fix and 3.0.3 is the latest release.

advisories.path: @docusaurus/core@3.10.2 > update-notifier@6.0.2 > latest-version@7.0.0 > package-json@8.1.1 > got@12.6.1 > cacheable-request@10.2.14 > http-cache-semantics@4.2.0
advisories.reason: The max-stale issue affects shared HTTP caches. This dependency is used only by Docusaurus's local CLI update checker and is absent from the generated static site; the project does not operate a cross-user cache. npm reports no fix and 4.2.0 is the latest release.
